data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has loss reserves for various events and for losses that are incurred but not reported (IBNR). Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its reserves for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value, particularly in context of losses where cedant statements are material. As a result of favourable experience during 2014, there has been a release of GBP 4.7m of prior year reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of prior year reserves of GBP 4.7m in 2014 driven by favourable claims experience during the year. The release reduced gross claims outstanding (opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2014 was GBP 25.444m). The movement is described at a syndicate level and is not broken down by line of business in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: release of GBP 4.7m of prior year reserves
volatility exists around the final settlement value

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 4.7m release) is taken from narrative in the 'Claims Outstanding' note; no detailed gross movement table or triangle was provided to disaggregate by line of business. The report does not explicitly state whether the GBP 4.7m is gross or net but the narrative does not use the word 'net' so it has been treated as a gross release. 'Pecuniary loss' in the segmental analysis was mapped to 'Casualty' for LOB movement entries; this mapping is approximate. No claims development triangle found in the report.
